sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy remains the market's sole all-green powerhouse, while Healthcare and Technology notch minor gains as Basic Materials begins to fade.

Energy continues its absolute dominance, holding the rank 1 spot with a momentum score of 0.950. It is the only sector out of 11 to achieve all-green status across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD) and remains sustained strong. Behind it, a minor rotation is underway as Healthcare (momentum 0.73), Technology (momentum 0.72), and Financials (momentum 0.68) each ticked up 1 spot in rank over the last five sessions.

Conversely, cyclical and defensive laggards are failing to find traction. Utilities (momentum 0.200) and Consumer Cyclicals (momentum 0.217) sit at the bottom of the momentum rankings. Meanwhile, Basic Materials is showing early signs of fatigue, dropping 1 spot to rank 3 despite holding a relatively strong momentum score of 0.68.

## Strength
* **Energy Dominance:** Energy is the only sector (1 of 11) to achieve all-green status, showing positive performance across the week, month, quarter, half, and YTD, with a top momentum score of 0.950.
* **Sustained Leadership:** Energy is the sole sector classified as sustained strong, maintaining its position in the top 3 across 1-month, 3-month, and 6-month ranks.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Financials (rank 6, momentum 0.68), Healthcare (rank 4, momentum 0.73), and Technology (rank 2, momentum 0.72) each improved by +1 spot over the last 5 sessions.
* **Top Losers:** Basic Materials (rank 3, momentum 0.68), Industrials (rank 5, momentum 0.22), and Real Estate (rank 7, momentum 0.35) each fell by -1 spot over the last 5 sessions.
* **Momentum Laggards:** Utilities (0.200), Consumer Cyclicals (0.217), and Industrials (0.217) anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
* **Basic Materials Fading:** Basic Materials exhibits an early-warning divergence, showing a strong momentum score of 0.68 but slipping -1 spot in rank over the last 5 sessions.
* **Industrials Momentum Gap:** Industrials sits at a moderate rank 5 but exhibits a weak momentum score of 0.217, indicating its mid-tier ranking is highly vulnerable.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and agricultural commodities dominate market strength, while uranium and travel-related services suffer sharp weekly declines.

Market breadth remains highly concentrated, with only 13 of 144 groups achieving "all-green" status across all timeframes. Market leadership is heavily anchored in the energy complex and shipping corridors, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (momentum 0.98) and Marine Shipping (momentum 0.91). Agricultural Inputs (+13 spots to rank 20) and Coking Coal (+24 spots to rank 38) are also showing powerful upward rotations.

Conversely, defensive metals and travel-related services are fading. Uranium plunged 28 spots to rank 83, while Lodging (-16 spots) and Travel Services (-15 spots) fell sharply. Additionally, Gold and Copper are exhibiting early signs of fading, losing rank despite maintaining relatively high momentum scores.

## Strength
* **Energy Dominance:** Oil & Gas subsectors represent the core of market strength, with Refining & Marketing (0.98 momentum), Integrated (0.86), E&P (0.83), and Drilling (0.83) all maintaining "all-green" status.
* **Sustained Leaders:** Marine Shipping (0.91 momentum) and Agricultural Inputs (0.86 momentum) remain among the top 36 industries across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
* **Narrow Breadth:** Only 9% of tracked groups (13 of 144) are positive across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, and YTD), highlighting a highly selective market environment.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Resource & Ag Surge:** Coking Coal (+24 spots to rank 38, momentum 0.86), Thermal Coal (+21 spots to rank 62, momentum 0.70), and Aluminum (+20 spots to rank 60, momentum 0.57) led the week's rank improvements.
* **Sharp Decliners:** Uranium experienced the steepest drop, falling 28 spots to rank 83, followed closely by Lodging (-16 spots to rank 71) and Textile Manufacturing (-15 spots to rank 44).
* **Deep Laggards:** Footwear & Accessories (0.072 momentum, rank 141) and Airports & Air Services (0.092 momentum, rank 140) continue to anchor the bottom of the momentum rankings.

## Divergences
* **Fading Momentum:** Gold (momentum 0.61) and Copper (momentum 0.67) are showing early fatigue, both dropping in rank (-13 and -6 spots respectively) over the last 5 sessions.
* **Emerging from the Bottom:** Discount Stores (+13 spots, momentum 0.40) and Internet Content & Information (+7 spots, momentum 0.46) are rising in rank despite currently low absolute momentum.
* **Service & Employment Slip:** Staffing & Employment Services (momentum 0.76) and Food Distribution (momentum 0.62) are losing ground, dropping 6 and 5 spots respectively.
